name: Pollinator Meadow — online play UI kit
format: SVG authored at 2x, rasterised with sharp density 72 then LANCZOS-halved to 1x. Textless files to ship, plus -en previews. Runtime font: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif.

strokes.note: Same thinner language as the ui-map revision. Authored even @2x (4 / 6) so LANCZOS 1x stays crisp.

P2.token: UI sky #7fc6e8 darkened, same a* b*, L* 76.5→70.0

P3.token: species pink #ff7eb6 darkened, same hue family

words.grid: Four category tabs × 16 words, each a 4×4 of 72 CSS px tiles (4×72 + 3×8 = 312 px square) with ~56 CSS px icons and 8 px gaps, per online-coop.md §3.1.1. Tabs are 72 CSS px (paw, fork, sun, teddy) with on/off states; a runtime label may be shown and can be hidden on small screens. Portrait: 4 code slots on top (with tab badges), then tabs, then the grid, then the typing button. Landscape: slots and tabs in a left column, grid on the right, no scrolling in a 390 px-tall viewport. Focus ring is a thick ink overlay plus a lift. After 3 typed letters, clover and cloud are offered as two chips (the only shared 3-letter start).

words.grouping_note: Tab placement follows the final lists in room-code-words.md and §3.1.1. The 64 words are unchanged; 16 words moved between the original themes so no tab holds a confusable pair (fox/frog, apple/orange, clover/cloud, puppy/hamster, crown/crayon, and the rest of the tab-rule list).

settings.gate_text: For grown-ups: press and hold for 3 seconds.
settings.direct_label: Direct mode: connect straight to friends' devices. This shares your internet address (IP) with their devices.
settings.direct_hint: Off (recommended): everything goes through the safe relay, and no one in the game sees your internet address.

colour_vision.method: Machado, Vieira & Oliveira 2009, severity 1.0, matrices applied in linear sRGB; CIE76 ΔE; grayscale from relative luminance (sRGB Rec. 709). Cream #fff3d8, ink #3b2614. Same pipeline as act3/ui class badges.
colour_vision.threshold: Grayscale ΔE < 10 is a fail (same threshold used for the class badges).
colour_vision.adjustment: The literal trio gold #ffd23f + UI sky token #7fc6e8 + species pink #ff7eb6 fails grayscale (P2 sky vs P3 pink ΔE 7.4, below the fail line of 10). Hues were kept. P2 was darkened to #6db4d6 (same a* b* as #7fc6e8, L* 76.5→70.0) and P3 was darkened to #d45890 (same pink hue family as #ff7eb6, lower L*), the same lightness move used for Bruiser on the class badges. P1 gold stays the game token #ffd23f. Second cues ship regardless: P1 circle + star, P2 rounded square + chevron, P3 hex + three dots. Name tags use the same fills, shapes, and marks; the left circle is an animal-glyph slot (no typed names).

spec_conflicts.brief: Older online-coop.md text said typing autocompletes after 2 letters.
spec_conflicts.spec: Both room-code-words.md and §3.1.1 now say after 3 letters. Clover/cloud is the only pair that still shares a 3-letter start; both are offered and the 4th letter decides.
spec_conflicts.kit: Follows the 3-letter rule. Join-type mockups show a “clo” field and clover/cloud choice chips. Typing is always on desktop and behind a keyboard button on touch.

spec_conflicts.brief: An older §3.1 example used OWL · ACORN · ROCKET · KITE.
spec_conflicts.spec: Both files now use OWL · CACTUS · ROCKET · PIANO.
spec_conflicts.kit: Mockups use OWL · CACTUS · ROCKET · PIANO.

spec_conflicts.brief: The job brief said “a 4-icon picture PIN pad.”
spec_conflicts.spec: §3.6 is a 4×4 pad of 16 icons; the PIN itself is 4 pictures long. Tiles must be at least 64 CSS px.
spec_conflicts.kit: Follows the spec: 16-icon 4×4 pad, 80 CSS px tiles, PIN length 4.

spec_conflicts.brief: Earlier kit drafts used an 8×8, then the original four theme lists with plant / sun-cloud / blocks glyphs. Fern later finalised tab placement and the picker UI.
spec_conflicts.spec: §3.1.1 and room-code-words.md: 4 tabs × 16 (Animals, Food & plants, Outside, Home & toys) with paw / fork / sun / teddy glyphs, 72 CSS px tiles, ~56 px icons, a focus ring, tab badges on code tiles, a typing button, and a clover/cloud choice after 3 letters. 16 words moved so no tab holds a confusable pair. PIN subset: frog → penguin, balloon → robot. Direct mode is only visible past the grown-up gate.
spec_conflicts.kit: This revision follows that spec. Nameplates keep the adopted colour-plus-shape cues (§3.2). Autocomplete is 3 letters. The example code is unchanged. Connection-failed and keep-screen-on use the exact §3.7 wording. The kit never falls back to direct. Landscape 64 px header fallback and Safari-toolbar 312 px fit (N2) are not verified in these full-390 mockups.
